افتريتن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَيْتُنَّ (iftaraytunna) /if.ta.raj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
# اُفْتُرِيتُنَّ (ufturītunna) /uf.tu.riː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
